dict.string: Houston captures the screen to take SnapShots of windows and panes and attach them to a conversation.
Houston uses Accessibility access to read the focused window's title for SnapShots and to drive the pane it captured.
Houston needs Full Disk Access to read project files and browser storage in the folders you open, including Safari's cookie database.
Houston reads project files in folders you open, including the Desktop.
Houston reads project files in folders you open, including Documents.
Houston reads project files in folders you open, including Downloads.
Houston reads project files in folders you open, including network volumes.
Houston reads project files in folders you open, including removable volumes.
